tourPromptBody: See HisabMitra with sample data: two months of income and expenses, money lent and borrowed, and a Goa trip split with friends. You can remove the sample data at the end.
tour1Body: Savings = income − expenses for the period. Switch between this month, last month and this year with the chips above.
tour2Title: Money to receive and to pay
tour2Body: Totals from your khata: money you lent and money you borrowed. Loans are kept separate from income and expenses.
tour3Body: Add income or an expense, give or receive money, create a group, split a group expense or open reports — one tap each.
tour4Title: Your hisab, also as a sheet
tour4Body: Every entry, day by day. Tap this table icon for an Excel-like sheet with income, expense and a running balance.
tour5Body: See who owes you and whom you owe. Open a person for the full ledger, partial repayments and due dates.
tour6Body: Split trips and family costs equally, by amounts, percentages or shares. Open the sample Goa Trip to see balances and settle-ups.
tour7Body: Reports with PDF and CSV export, calculator, reminders, backup, the AI assistant, and settings for colour theme, language and the Gujarati keyboard.
tourFinishBody: Keep the sample data to explore a little more, or remove it and start your own hisab. You can replay the tour any time from More.
sampleBanner: You are looking at sample data.
sampleRemoveBody: Sample entries, people and the sample group are removed. Everything you added yourself stays — a sample person or group you used is kept.
moreAppTourDesc: A one-minute guided tour with sample data
